from pathlib import Path
import json,re
DATA=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
config=json.loads((DATA/'autobuild_control_route.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
route_task=str(config.get('route_task_id') or '')
route_path=DATA/'routes'/f'{route_task}.json'
if not route_path.is_file():
 print('ASTRA_ROUTE_BINDING=MISSING',flush=True); raise SystemExit(71)
route=json.loads(route_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
chat=str(route.get('chat_id') or '')
consumer=route.get('consumer_id')
print('ASTRA_ROUTE_TASK='+route_task,flush=True)
print('ASTRA_ROUTE_CHAT_PRESENT='+('YES' if chat else 'NO'),flush=True)
print('ASTRA_ROUTE_CONSUMER='+('NONE' if consumer in (None,'') else 'PINNED'),flush=True)
installed=(DATA/'bridge_server.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
chat_scoped=('chat_scoped_route_binding' in installed or 'consumer_id": None' in installed or "'consumer_id': None" in installed)
print('INSTALLED_CHAT_SCOPED_ROUTE='+('YES' if chat_scoped else 'NO'),flush=True)
if consumer not in (None,'') and not chat_scoped: raise SystemExit(72)
if not chat: raise SystemExit(73)
raise SystemExit(0)
